inputs.description: Filing Status (SINGLE, MFJ, MFS, HOH, QSS)

Medical Expense Items. Each item has: item_id (string), source_document_id (string), taxpayer_paid_amount (float), reimbursement_amount (float), tax_free_medical_account_payment (float), eligible_person_status (string: ELIGIBLE, NOT_ELIGIBLE, UNKNOWN), medical_qualification_status (string: QUALIFIED_SIMPLE, UNKNOWN), paid_in_tax_year (boolean).

Tax Payment Items. Each item has: item_id (string), source_document_id (string), amount_paid (float), separately_stated_nondeductible_charge (float), tax_category (string: STATE_LOCAL_INCOME_TAX, GENERAL_SALES_TAX, PERSONAL_REAL_ESTATE_TAX, PERSONAL_PROPERTY_TAX, FEDERAL_OR_NONDEDUCTIBLE_TAX, BUSINESS_OR_RENTAL_TAX, UNKNOWN), description (string), paid_in_tax_year (boolean), personal_use_confirmed (boolean), actual_paid_to_taxing_authority_confirmed (boolean; set to false if the payment is only to an escrow account, such as Form 1098 Box 10, without confirmation of actual payment to the taxing authority), value_based_and_annual_confirmed (boolean).

Mortgage Interest Items. Each item has: item_id (string), source_document_id (string), source_document_type (string), lender_name (string), form_1098_box_1_mortgage_interest (float), deductible_points_reported_on_1098 (float), property_use_context (string: MAIN_HOME, SECOND_HOME, RENTAL_PROPERTY, BUSINESS_PROPERTY, UNKNOWN), simple_mortgage_status (string: CONFIRMED_SIMPLE, UNKNOWN), paid_in_tax_year (boolean).

Cash Charity Items. Each item has: item_id (string), source_document_id (string), organization_name (string), gross_contribution_amount (float), goods_or_services_value (float), paid_in_tax_year (boolean), contribution_date (string, e.g. YYYY-MM-DD), qualified_organization_status (string: VERIFIED, UNKNOWN), bank_or_written_record_available (boolean), contemporaneous_acknowledgment_received (boolean).

Standard Deduction Reference. Properties: must_itemize_due_to_mfs_spouse (boolean, optional; set to true if spouse itemizes on a separate return), elect_itemize_even_if_less (boolean, optional; set to true if taxpayer elects to itemize even if it is less than standard deduction).

Special Case Flags. Set a property to true only if explicitly stated in documents. Properties:
- has_marketplace_medical_premium (boolean): Marketplace/Form 1095-A/Form 8962 premiums present.
- has_ltc_premium (boolean): Long-term care insurance premium present.
- has_self_employed_health_insurance_overlap (boolean): Self-employed health insurance coordination present.
- has_prior_year_medical_recovery (boolean): Prior-year medical recovery/refund present.
- sales_tax_amount_requires_calculation (boolean): Sales tax requires tables/calculation.
- has_tax_refund_or_rebate_adjustment (boolean): Tax refund/rebate adjustment present.
- has_form_2555_or_4563_or_puerto_rico_exclusion (boolean): Form 2555, Form 4563, or Puerto Rico exclusion context.
- has_other_tax_line_6 (boolean): Other taxes for Line 6 present.
- has_multiple_schedule_a_mortgages (boolean): Set to true ONLY when taxpayer has more than one mortgage relevant to Schedule A home mortgage interest computation (Main Home or Second Home). Do NOT count mortgages belonging to rental properties, business properties, or other properties whose interest is reported on Schedule E or Schedule C.
- mortgage_proceeds_not_all_qualified (boolean): Mortgage proceeds not fully used to buy/build/improve qualified home.
- mortgage_limitation_required (boolean): Mortgage principal exceeds IRS limits, limitation worksheet required.
- has_shared_mortgage (boolean): Shared/co-owned mortgage interest present.
- has_non_1098_mortgage_interest (boolean): Mortgage interest not reported on Form 1098.
- has_non_1098_points (boolean): Points not reported on Form 1098.
- has_seller_financed_mortgage (boolean): Seller-financed mortgage.
- has_form_8396_credit (boolean): Form 8396 Mortgage Interest Credit.
- has_investment_interest (boolean): Investment interest/Form 4952 present.
- has_noncash_charity (boolean): Noncash charity/Form 8283 present.
- has_charity_carryover (boolean): Charitable contribution carryover.
- has_charitable_agi_limitation (boolean): Charitable AGI limitation applies.
- has_casualty_or_theft_loss (boolean): Casualty/theft loss/Form 4684 present.
- has_net_qualified_disaster_loss (boolean): Net qualified disaster loss.
- has_line_16_item (boolean): Line 16 other itemized deduction.
- has_unresolved_mfs_joint_expense_allocation (boolean): MFS joint expense allocation unresolved.
